title: Design Studio Options and the Additional Deposit Rate on a Home Purchase Agreement
content:
**Studio liaison note.** The additional deposit rate of a Home Purchase Agreement is uplifted by the studio options Calloway is building into the home, read from the buyer's Design Studio Selections file for the agreement — its status and its option total:

- where the file is **structurally closed, finalized or delivered** and its option total is **at least 60000.00**, **0.6 percentage points** are added;
- where the file is in one of those statuses and its option total is **at least 30000.00 but below 60000.00**, **0.3 percentage points** are added;
- otherwise nothing is added.

## Judgement table

| Design Studio Selections file status | Option total | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| Structurally closed, finalized or delivered | 60000.00 or more | 0.6 |
| Structurally closed, finalized or delivered | 30000.00 up to 59999.99 | 0.3 |
| Structurally closed, finalized or delivered | Below 30000.00 | Nothing |
| Any other status (for example still in selection, or cancelled) | Any amount | Nothing |
| No file for the agreement | — | Nothing |

## Both sides of the thresholds (hypothetical files)

- A structurally closed file at 60000.00 adds 0.6; at 59999.99 it adds 0.3.
- A finalized file at 30000.00 adds 0.3; at 29999.99 it adds nothing.
- A file still in selection at 95000.00 adds nothing.
